categories.main_business_segments: Sansec Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on cryptographic technology innovation and the development, sales, and services of commercial cryptographic products. Its main product lines include cryptographic chips, cryptographic cards, cryptographic machines, and cryptographic systems, serving network information security needs across government, finance, telecommunications, energy, and emerging sectors like cloud computing, big data, blockchain, digital currency, IoT, V2X, and AI.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary cryptographic chip technology supporting national cryptographic algorithms (SM series, ZUC, etc.), high-performance cryptographic hardware and software integration, and advanced cryptographic modules with features like hardware virtualization, anti-quantum cryptography, and cloud-native cryptographic services. Production combines in-house manufacturing for core processes (programming, testing, assembly) with outsourced PCB soldering, following order-based and stock-based production models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sansec serves primarily network security product and solution providers who integrate its cryptographic products, as well as direct end customers in sectors such as government, finance, securities, tax, energy, telecommunications, public security, and emerging digital economy fields. The company has expanded its direct sales to strategic end users while maintaining strong partnerships with major cloud service providers like Huawei Cloud, JD Cloud, and China Mobile Cloud.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters in Beijing and subsidiaries across major cities including Jinan, Shanghai, Nanjing, Xi'an, Chongqing, and Guangxi. It has begun international expansion by establishing a Hong Kong subsidiary to serve the Asia-Pacific market and support overseas clients, including collaborations with global financial institutions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sansec operates primarily in the upstream segment of the network information security supply chain as a provider of core cryptographic infrastructure products such as chips, cards, machines, and systems. It supplies these foundational components to midstream network security solution integrators and downstream end users across various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in cryptographic technologies, including IoT security chips, high-performance cryptographic algorithms, cloud-native cryptographic services, and post-quantum cryptography. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on expanding product lines, enhancing performance and security, and developing solutions for data lifecycle protection, privacy computing, and secure multi-party computation aligned with national digital security strategies.
categories.revenue_model: Sansec generates revenue primarily through direct sales of cryptographic products (chips, cards, machines, systems) and provision of cryptographic technical services such as consulting, maintenance, and support. It also offers subscription-based cryptographic security services enabling on-demand access to cryptographic capabilities via cloud platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic commercial cryptographic infrastructure provider, recognized among the top tier of Chinese cryptographic firms. It competes with other domestic cryptographic product manufacturers and benefits from strong government policy support. Its partnerships with major cloud providers and certifications like FIPS 140-2 Level 3 enhance its competitive standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Sansec reported revenue of approximately RMB 358.6 million, a 5.54% increase year-over-year, driven by market expansion and acquisition of Jiangnan Keyou. Net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 37.26% due to increased R&D and sales investments. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 2.08 billion and continues to increase R&D spending, which accounted for 27.43% of revenue in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sansec emphasizes its proprietary cryptographic chip technology, comprehensive product portfolio supporting national cryptographic standards, and high-performance, secure, and reliable cryptographic solutions tailored for critical infrastructure and emerging digital economy applications. Its integration capabilities, certifications, and strategic partnerships provide customers with trusted, domestically controlled cryptographic infrastructure that meets stringent security and compliance requirements.
